privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy

runs.text: Kasumigaseki MENA respects the privacy of website visitors, business contacts, candidates, prospective investors, suppliers, restaurant guests, and other individuals who interact with this website or contact us through the details provided on it.
This policy explains the categories of information we may collect, how we use it, when it may be shared, and the choices available to users.
Kasumigaseki MENA is the regional subsidiary of Kasumigaseki Capital Co., Ltd., headquartered in Tokyo. For privacy enquiries relating to this website, contact
info.dubai@kasumigaseki.co.jp

We may collect information that you voluntarily provide, including your name, email address, telephone number, company, role, enquiry details, employment information, preferred location, restaurant or meeting request details, and any message or attachment you submit by email or through website forms.

We may also collect technical and usage information, such as IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, referring URLs, approximate location inferred from technical data, consent choices, and date and time of access.

We may use information to respond to enquiries, manage business relationships, consider investment or partnership opportunities, handle recruitment and career communications, coordinate visits or meetings, provide requested information, maintain website security, understand website usage, improve content, and meet legal, regulatory, compliance, accounting, or governance requirements.

Where applicable law requires a legal basis, we process personal information based on consent, legitimate business interests, steps taken at your request before entering into an arrangement, performance of a contract, compliance with legal obligations, or protection of legal rights and security.
For non-essential cookies or usage measurement, we rely on the cookie and usage consent choices presented on this website where required.

We may share information with Kasumigaseki Capital group companies, affiliates, professional advisers, service providers, hosting providers, IT support, analytics or media providers, recruitment support providers, and relevant authorities where needed for the purposes described in this policy.
We do not sell personal information.

Because Kasumigaseki MENA operates as part of an international group, information may be accessed or processed in the United Arab Emirates, Japan, the United States, Malaysia, or other jurisdictions where group companies, service providers, or partners operate. We take reasonable steps to protect information when it is transferred or accessed internationally.

We retain information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, including responding to enquiries, managing relationships, maintaining records, resolving disputes, complying with legal obligations, and supporting internal governance. Retention periods may vary depending on the type of information and applicable requirements.
This website may use cookies, local storage, server logs, embedded media, maps, fonts, and similar technologies. Details are available in our
Cookie Policy
. You can manage consent through the cookie banner or the cookie settings control on the Cookie Policy page.

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection, portability, withdrawal of consent, or information about how your personal data is used. We may need to verify your identity before responding to a request.
Requests may be sent to
info.dubai@kasumigaseki.co.jp
. We will respond as reasonably practicable and in accordance with applicable law.

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures to protect information. No online transmission, website, email system, or storage method can be guaranteed as completely secure.
This website is not directed to children and is intended for business, investor, media, candidate, and general corporate audiences.
We may update this policy as our website, services, or legal requirements change. The latest version will be posted on this page.

cookie-policy.title: Cookie Policy

sections.heading: What cookies and similar technologies are

runs.text: Cookies are small text files placed on a browser or device by a website or related service. Similar technologies include local storage, pixels, tags, scripts, embedded media, and server logs. They help websites operate, remember preferences, measure usage, maintain security, and support third-party features.

When you first visit this website, a consent notice may ask whether you agree to optional cookies and usage measurement. Essential technologies are used where needed for the website to function. Optional usage and media technologies are used only according to the choice you make where consent is required.

items.text: required for core website operation, security, consent storage, page navigation, and basic functionality.
helps us understand how visitors use the website so we can improve content, performance, and user experience. Usage data is intended to be used in aggregated or statistical form.

runs.text: This website may link to or load resources from third-party providers, including map platforms, video or media platforms, social media, font providers, analytics tools, and group company websites. These providers may set cookies or collect technical information when you interact with their services.

Your cookie and usage consent preference is stored in your browser using local storage so the website can remember your selection. If you clear browser storage or use another device, the consent notice may appear again.
Most browsers allow you to block, delete, or manage cookies through settings. Blocking certain cookies may affect website performance or availability of media, maps, or other features.
This policy may be updated as website features, third-party services, or legal requirements change. The latest version will be posted on this page.
